apps.name: AuraLyrics
apps.subtitle: Floating Spotify lyrics for macOS
apps.description: Minimalist, always-on-top lyrics window for Spotify with menu bar controls.
apps.longDescription: AuraLyrics displays real-time synchronized lyrics in a floating window on macOS. It reads playback state from the Spotify desktop app through Spotify's own scripting interface — no API keys or accounts — and looks lyrics up in the LRCLIB community database. Aura mode fills the window with an ambient background that takes its colour from the album art. Native Swift and SwiftUI, no third-party libraries, no telemetry.
apps.brew: brew tap ozcberkay/tap && brew trust ozcberkay/tap && brew install --cask auralyrics
apps.requirements: macOS 14.0 or later; Spotify desktop app
features: Aura mode — ambient background coloured by the album art
Adaptive, dark aura and minimalist themes
Two-layer cache for instant repeat playback
No accounts, no API keys, no telemetry
